whyChess.heading: Every child deserves a head start.
whyChess.introduction: From the first lesson to tournament play, we guide and support children as they learn to think ahead and grow through the game.
benefitDescriptions: Compare choices, notice patterns and think one move ahead.
Practice staying attentive as each position changes.
Take time to weigh options and follow a plan.
Learn from each game and grow comfortable making decisions.
Break a challenging position into smaller questions and test ideas.

items.answer: Explore the Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced levels on the Courses page. Message us for placement guidance.

levelDescriptions: Learn piece movement, board rules, check and checkmate, and how to spot simple threats.
Build tactical awareness, opening principles, and the habit of planning ahead.
Sharpen calculation, positional planning, and endgame technique with challenging positions.
